source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As each [battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) begins, you can pick one of the 2 Doctrina Imperatives below. Your army has it active for the rest of the battle round, and your units with this ability get its abilities.

With **PROTECTOR IMPERATIVE** active:

- Ranged weapons of the unit's models get **[[HEAVY]](vsdata:weapon-ability/heavy)** and +1 BS.
- If the unit is **BATTLELINE**, or is up to 6" from one or more **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE** units of yours, melee attacks against it get -1 to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls).

With **CONQUEROR IMPERATIVE** active:

- Ranged weapons of the unit's models get **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)**.
- Melee weapons of the unit's models get +1 WS.
- Under the same **BATTLELINE** condition, attacks by the unit's models get +1 AP.
